# Support

This page lists the support channels for A3SQL.

## Support guide

See [SUPPORT.md](https://github.com/lErrorl404l/A3SQL/blob/main/SUPPORT.md)
for the support guide. It links the README, the contributing guide, and the
changelog.

## Security

Report a vulnerability privately to the maintainer. See
[SECURITY.md](https://github.com/lErrorl404l/A3SQL/blob/main/SECURITY.md) for
the reporting process.

## Issues

Report a bug or request a feature through the GitHub issue tracker:

- [Bug report](https://github.com/lErrorl404l/A3SQL/issues/new?labels=bug&template=bug_report.md)
- [Feature request](https://github.com/lErrorl404l/A3SQL/issues/new?labels=enhancement&template=feature_request.md)

## Discussions

Ask questions and discuss the mod in GitHub
[Discussions](https://github.com/lErrorl404l/A3SQL/discussions).
